_readme: DOCUMENTATION — the MCP-candidate selection decision record. No code reads this file back; mcp/server.mjs's actual tool list is the live equivalent (see mcp/tool-schema-snapshot.json, which IS checked, by tests/mcp.test.mjs). Labelled 2026-08-23 (P8-084).

selected.name: doc-visuals
selected.storage: local filesystem only — renders/current/ inside the engine folder

candidates_evaluated.name: apache/echarts-mcp
reasons: default storage uploads generated images to Baidu BCE cloud — disqualifying for internal/confidential audit data (spec §7.1, §31)
supports only 8 series types (bar, line, pie, scatter, funnel, tree, treemap, sunburst)
run method is npm run dev (not a published package); selecting it means owning a fork

candidates_evaluated.name: hustcc/mcp-echarts
reasons: local generation confirmed (base64 fallback) and actively maintained — the strongest external candidate
but dependency surface exceeds need: minio (S3 client), express (HTTP server), dotenv, @napi-rs/canvas native binding
exposes arbitrary full-option rendering — no project-theme enforcement, no confidentiality gate, no preset knowledge
project facade reuses the direct adapter, adds zero new deps beyond @modelcontextprotocol/sdk+zod (already the tools/mcp-server stack), and keeps validation single-sourced

revisit_when: external MCP needed by a non-Node consumer, or facade maintenance exceeds the cost of wrapping hustcc/mcp-echarts with a validation proxy
